newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel prices ease as diffs weaken again.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel prices ease as diffs weaken again.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices eased Wednesday as both differentials the NYMEX slid lower.
Activity remained quiet, traders said, with many players en route from the National Petroleum Refiners Association conference, which ended Tuesday in San Antonio.

U.S. Gulf 54-grade fuel for delivery on the back 9th cycle of the Colonial pipeline was done at even with the NYMEX print, down about 0.50 cent on the day. That diff had slipped more than 1.0 cent on Tuesday.
New York Harbor 54-grade diffs also weakened, with prompt barrels talked on either side of 3.00 cents over the screen.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
